stages.title: Correct mandatory XML checks independently
acceptance: Add narrow regression contracts before any parser change.
Reject duplicate expanded attributes and misplaced DOCTYPE in all decode modes, including skipped subtrees; retain legal prologs and omitted XML declarations.
Preserve namespace/depth checks and current permissive MusicXML behavior.

stages.title: Correct attribute and schema-instance contracts independently
acceptance: Close simple/builtin attribute-validation gaps while retaining complex-type checks.
Give each of the four standard xsi attributes its own reviewed value and applicability contract; never fetch location hints.

stages.title: Separate exact XSD domains from Go conversion independently
acceptance: Test machine boundaries and staves=2^64 with an independent source-XSD oracle.
Budget exact integer/decimal operations; distinguish normative domain failure, incomplete assessment and model conversion failure.

stages.title: Formalize and verify shared operators
acceptance: Approve bounded catalog/selector/dependency semantics without freezing sketch API names.
Verify reuse of grammar, scalar/facet/default and ID-index helpers contract by contract.
Compile one plan per obligation and preserve required but unimplemented support entries.

stages.title: Build opt-in single-pass source adapter
acceptance: Observe source facts below every skip/filter and expand namespaces once.
Consume non-seekable input once, drain the same parser after recoverable conversion failure, and finalize at EOF.
Preserve mandatory XML/security limits and enable only explicitly selected, bounded profiles.

stages.title: Build direct current-model adapter
acceptance: Walk generated/current model facts without Encode or an XML parser.
Publish field-level presence/branch/order/value/lexeme capabilities and normative representable-absence checks.
Protect typed nil, choice, cycles, depth and traversal volume; do not claim source history.

stages.title: Select and implement bounded local semantics
acceptance: Review all 29 candidates, including existing bend-release-negative, without adding duplicates.
Approve exact clauses/selectors for accordion, beam numbers, key-octave cancel, concert-score/for-part and typed scoped references.
Inventory excluded and dependency-limited obligations; no broad-completeness claim from the selected slice.

stages.title: Add musical context and effective-state services
acceptance: Use document/part/staff/voice-qualified musical positions and exact context provenance.
Add chord/base, divisions, backup/forward, effective key and reviewed repeat/span services without invented initial defaults.
Keep intent unavailable, unsupported capability, invalid prerequisites and proven inapplicability distinct.

stages.title: Add bounded package and external adapters
acceptance: Reuse MXL path/container/mimetype/rootfile/limit checks; isolate opus/link/package scope.
Resolve only authorized selected dependencies with pinned identities, shared budgets, stream cleanup and cycle controls.
Declare exactly which dictionary and external-specification obligations are closed; retain unknown/unsupported for remaining closure.

stages.title: Complete diagnostics, security and compatibility
acceptance: Treat required security guards and honest incomplete reporting as entry gates for every earlier implementation slice, not work to postpone until this stage.
Review richer reports and legacy error behavior together; exact exported API remains a separate decision.
Bound every resource and diagnostic channel, preserve cancellation causes, and keep no-automatic-fetch behavior.

stages.title: Prove profile readiness
acceptance: Run relevant regression/unit suites and standard generation, formatting, vet, three-OS tests, race, fuzz and independent XSD CI.
Use raw-source differential tests plus mandatory-obligation coverage, rather than corpus size, as readiness evidence.
A narrow profile may ship only when its declared obligations are checked or its incomplete outcomes are explicit and verified.

stages.title: Resolve bounded design and language decisions
acceptance: Record API/catalog/profile decisions before implementing affected contracts; this is a parallel decision lane, not a requirement to block all work.
Disposition each of the 28 issues clause by clause without treating issue records as hard-error authority.
Translate the remaining 291 prose records alongside selected predicates/context facts, preserving originals and provenance.

stages.title: Evaluate optional evidence and schema maintenance
acceptance: Accept or decline each optional proposal separately.
If elected, prove byte-preserving opus replacement or safe quotations/snapshots without expanding baseline readiness obligations.

requirements.title: Reject duplicate attributes by expanded name
requirements.applicability: Every parsed start tag in permissive and strict modes
acceptance: Reject same-name and same-expanded-name duplicates as XML failures before model filtering.

requirements.title: Enforce document-level DOCTYPE placement
requirements.applicability: Every source document, regardless of MusicXML strictness
acceptance: Permit a legal single prolog DOCTYPE and reject inside-root, post-root or repeated DOCTYPE.
Do not require an XML declaration.

requirements.title: Keep syntax and limits active below every skipping path
requirements.applicability: Known and skipped source subtrees in all decode entry points
acceptance: XML checks cannot be bypassed by namespace filtering or Skip.
Preserve once-only namespace expansion and existing depth behavior.

requirements.title: Validate attributes on simple and builtin typed elements
requirements.applicability: Simple-typed and builtin-typed source elements
acceptance: Validate attribute admissibility for staves and step as well as complex types.

requirements.title: Preserve complex-type attribute facets and defaults
requirements.applicability: Declared attributes on complex types
acceptance: Retain required, permitted, fixed, enumeration and datatype checks with effective defaults separate from lexical presence.

requirements.title: Resolve xsi:type QName and permitted derivation
requirements.applicability: xsi:type is present
acceptance: Resolve QName in the subject namespace scope and enforce reviewed derivation/block constraints; do not accept arbitrary type names.

requirements.title: Validate xsi:nil lexical form and nillability
requirements.applicability: xsi:nil is present
acceptance: Check the XSD boolean contract, declaration nillability and nil-content constraints.

requirements.title: Validate xsi:schemaLocation pairs without fetching
requirements.applicability: xsi:schemaLocation is present
acceptance: Validate the standard namespace/location list contract; a hint is not a fetch instruction.

requirements.title: Validate xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation value without fetching
requirements.applicability: xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation is present
acceptance: Recognize the standard attribute and validate its actual datatype instead of rejecting it as unallowed or accepting all xsi values.

requirements.title: Separate unbounded XSD integers from machine ranges
requirements.applicability: Every selected XSD integer-family obligation
acceptance: Use actual bounded or unbounded XSD domain facets, not int64/uint64 parsing limits.
Preserve exact integer value through shared comparisons.

requirements.title: Use bounded exact integer and decimal operations
requirements.applicability: Numeric parsing, facets, comparisons and contextual arithmetic
acceptance: Specify exact operations, allocation/step limits, immutable values and parse-once caching.
No float64 substitution for source decimal value-space comparisons.

requirements.title: Report conversion separately and continue source assessment
requirements.applicability: Assessed decode whose model mapper cannot represent a value
acceptance: Keep source conformance separate from unrepresentable Go mapping.
Discard partial model and preserve conversion cause while same parser completes source when safe.

requirements.title: Bind executable obligations to versioned evidence and selectors
requirements.applicability: Every planned runtime predicate or fact provider
acceptance: Specify stable candidate runtime ID/revision, provenance, exact selector/scope, parameters, applicability and adapter capabilities.
Research record IDs remain provenance; 2,560 records are not asserted to be independent predicates.

requirements.title: Separate execution role, normative force and dependencies
requirements.applicability: Each formalized research condition
acceptance: Record predicate/context_fact/advisory/out_of_scope independently from external dictionary, linked document or author-intent requirements.
Do not exclude renderer/exporter records automatically.

requirements.title: Specify shared typed operator and dependency semantics
requirements.applicability: Catalog compilation and every assessment session
acceptance: Review scalar, grammar, count/presence, default, identity and contextual operators without treating sketch names as a frozen DSL.
Reject dependency cycles; run prerequisites first and suppress duplicate consequences.

requirements.title: Split equivalent and additional XSD/prose conditions
requirements.applicability: Research entries overlapping generated schema constraints
acceptance: Full semantic equivalence contributes provenance to one predicate.
Partial overlap separates the shared condition from extra prose obligations.

requirements.title: Maintain obligation-to-target test traceability and limits
requirements.applicability: All selected mandatory obligations and documented exclusions
acceptance: Trace source -> condition -> predicate -> source/model -> positive/negative/boundary and missing/interaction cases.
Uncheckable obligations carry a reason and measurable closure criterion.

requirements.title: Verify full particle semantics before matcher reuse
requirements.applicability: Selected XSD child-grammar obligations
acceptance: Prove sequence/choice, nested nullable branches, bounded/unbounded repetition and matching-work bounds.

requirements.title: Verify facets, union ordering and default normalization
inputs: scalar lexemes or current model values
requirements.applicability: Selected scalar/facet/default contracts
acceptance: Review whitespace and pattern semantics, union declaration order, value spaces, facet layering, defaults/fixed and date restrictions.

requirements.title: Finalize scoped identity indexes with causal resolution
requirements.applicability: Selected generic and typed identity obligations
acceptance: Finalize document-wide IDs after EOF/full traversal and distinguish declarations from references.
Preserve ambiguity and typed/owner-scope constraints.

requirements.title: Keep strict source assessment explicit and permissive default
requirements.applicability: Public decode/assessment entry-point orchestration
acceptance: Nil assessment retains permissive MusicXML decoding with mandatory XML/security checks.
Strict profile selection is explicit; unknown/empty/incompatible profile fails before consuming input.

requirements.title: Observe unfiltered source once and finish only at EOF
requirements.applicability: Source-only assessment and opt-in assessed decode
acceptance: Keep one parser/namespace expansion, with observation before token filtering or mutation.
At EOF finalize document checks; return a model only after successful conversion and accepted strict report.

requirements.title: Replace serialization validation with direct shared facts
requirements.applicability: Explicit current-model assessment and reviewed legacy facade
acceptance: Traverse models directly without Encode, marshal or parser calls, including fast paths.
Reuse compiled plans rather than implement a second XSD engine.

requirements.title: Map evidence capability per concrete model field
requirements.applicability: Every selected model obligation
acceptance: Record presence, branch, order, exact value and lexeme per field/obligation.
Document mandatory scalar presence loss, singular occurrence collapse, float64 rounding and integer range limits.

requirements.title: Guard current model graphs and representable required absence
requirements.applicability: Direct model traversal
acceptance: Handle typed nils, invalid choice members, cycles, depth and traversal volume before unsafe traversal.
Known representable absence of required child/attribute is normative, distinct from model shape failure.

requirements.title: Disposition all 29 first-profile candidates exactly once
requirements.applicability: First implementation profile review
acceptance: Review all 29 remaining records rather than the reviewer list of 28.
Include existing MX40-PROSE-bend-release-negative without inserting a duplicate catalog record.

requirements.title: Formalize initial local presence, uniqueness and target relations
requirements.applicability: Reviewed selected local accordion, beam, key-octave, concert-score/for-part and typed target conditions
acceptance: Define each selected relation at clause-level before implementation; no claim that an illustrative local slice completes a broad profile.

requirements.title: Separate document/part/staff/voice scope and linked-file evidence
requirements.applicability: Selected local references and linked-part obligations
acceptance: Specify scope keys and separate local typed instrument IDREF from linked-part existence/content.
Do not require identical external ID spelling without clause-level support.

requirements.title: Build explicit musical-time and effective-state facts
requirements.applicability: Selected rules requiring musical positions or inherited state
acceptance: Define chord/base-note relation, divisions and backup/forward arithmetic, effective key and reviewed repeat/span context.
Never invent initial C major, 4/4, clef or divisions=1.

requirements.title: Distinguish applicability from unknown, unsupported and blocked
requirements.applicability: Every selected rule instance
acceptance: Represent pass, violation, not-applicable, unknown, unsupported and blocked distinctly.
A deferred rule is not automatically unsupported on documents where applicability is provably false.

requirements.title: Declare target, version, subtree/package boundaries and closure
requirements.applicability: Every advertised profile and report
acceptance: Name source/model/subtree/package boundaries, version-selection policy, required obligations and support limitations.
Initial musicxml/opus assemblies do not imply container/sounds support without generation/tests.

requirements.title: Separate MXL, opus and link adapters
requirements.applicability: Selected package/link profiles
acceptance: Reuse verified path, mimetype, container/rootfile and budget checks under package-specific evidence.
Do not claim complete ZIP/JAR semantics from current helpers.

requirements.title: Resolve only explicit dependencies with verified ownership
requirements.applicability: External linked documents, dictionaries or intent needed by selected profile
acceptance: No automatic network traversal; resolve only selected dependencies after local prerequisites pass.
Validate payload kind/scope/identity/revision, close every transferred body and share bounded parse resources.

requirements.title: Pin canonical SMuFL dictionary capability
requirements.applicability: Profiles claiming selected canonical glyph membership
acceptance: Verify dictionary identity/version and actual canonical membership; prefix checks alone do not close this obligation.

requirements.title: Pin IPA repertoire and combining-character contract
requirements.applicability: Profiles claiming IPA validity
acceptance: Review exact repertoire and combining behavior before claiming complete IPA validation.

requirements.title: Close only claimed XML/XSD/link/archive dependencies
requirements.applicability: Capabilities claimed for XML/XSD/XLink/XML Base/ID and ZIP/JAR/DEFLATE
acceptance: Map each claimed capability to reviewed external clauses and tests.
Full transitive normative closure remains unclaimed until dependencies are actually verified.

requirements.title: Report conformance independently from assessment completion
requirements.applicability: Every source/model/package report
acceptance: Acceptance requires requested complete input, correct syntax state, conformant and complete assessment, and zero required blockers.
err==nil is not an acceptance test; zero/unrequested report is not satisfied.

requirements.title: Provide offline actionable, causal diagnostics
requirements.applicability: Every emitted normative or technical diagnostic
acceptance: Include stable candidate ID/revision, target/path, reason/category, expected/actual, related places, concise English explanation and source URL without network.

requirements.title: Keep syntax, normative, model, capability, resource and advisory distinct
requirements.applicability: All report aggregation and error classification
acceptance: Classify fatal XML, MusicXML violation, model invariant, unsupported capability and resource/security limit separately.
Recommendations appear separately and never inflate mandatory failures.

requirements.title: Review and test legacy sentinel and typed-error bridge
requirements.applicability: Legacy Validate/Decode/MXL compatibility and explicit new assessment paths
acceptance: Preserve established identities/recognition where applicable only after explicit API review; document unavoidable changes.
Do not silently broaden legacy XSD-only Validate to all new prose.

requirements.title: Bound and localize diagnostics without inventing locations
requirements.applicability: Diagnostic storage and formatting
acceptance: Limit count and bytes, trim/escape hostile values, preserve stable IDs across localization and provide offline fallback text.
Use mapped original/transcoded positions only; never fabricate source lines for new models.

requirements.title: Preserve no-automatic-fetch and honest XML capability limits
requirements.applicability: All source and linked-document parsers
acceptance: Never automatically load schemas, DTDs, external entities or XInclude.
Specify allowed but unsupported XML features as capability/security boundaries.

requirements.title: Define finite shared resource accounting semantics
requirements.applicability: Every assessment and nested resolver run
acceptance: Zero selects finite documented defaults; negative/impossible values fail before read.
Share one account across reader/adapter/engine/loader/children; define owners to avoid double charging.
Cumulative quotas cannot be refunded; live gauges may release; scalar cap is per-item.

requirements.title: Bound input bytes
requirements.applicability: All selected evaluations consuming this resource
acceptance: Define accounting for raw bounded reader bytes using MaxInputBytes; exhaustion is resource/incomplete rather than a MusicXML failure.

requirements.title: Bound unpacked and external bytes
inputs: decompressed entry and linked body bytes
requirements.applicability: All selected evaluations consuming this resource
acceptance: Define accounting for decompressed entry and linked body bytes using MaxExternalBytes plus existing MXL limits; exhaustion is resource/incomplete rather than a MusicXML failure.

requirements.title: Bound retained buffer bytes
requirements.applicability: All selected evaluations consuming this resource
acceptance: Define accounting for live retained scalar/token/context snapshots using MaxBufferedBytes; exhaustion is resource/incomplete rather than a MusicXML failure.

requirements.title: Bound xml and model traversal depth
inputs: active XML elements and model recursion
requirements.applicability: All selected evaluations consuming this resource
acceptance: Define accounting for active XML elements and model recursion using MaxDepth plus existing depth guards; exhaustion is resource/incomplete rather than a MusicXML failure.

requirements.title: Bound tokens, nodes and events

explicit token/event measurement mapped to MaxNodes/MaxRuleSteps or reviewed added limits
requirements.applicability: All selected evaluations consuming this resource
acceptance: Define accounting for raw tokens and emitted node/event steps using explicit token/event measurement mapped to MaxNodes/MaxRuleSteps or reviewed added limits; exhaustion is resource/incomplete rather than a MusicXML failure.

requirements.title: Bound attributes
requirements.applicability: All selected evaluations consuming this resource

requirements.title: Bound scalar length
requirements.applicability: All selected evaluations consuming this resource
acceptance: Define accounting for XML-normalized scalar bytes before parsing/allocation using MaxScalarBytes; exhaustion is resource/incomplete rather than a MusicXML failure.

requirements.title: Bound identity-index size
inputs: ID declarations and retained reference/index entries
requirements.applicability: All selected evaluations consuming this resource
acceptance: Define accounting for ID declarations and retained reference/index entries using MaxIDs with reviewed reference accounting; exhaustion is resource/incomplete rather than a MusicXML failure.

requirements.title: Bound matching and operator complexity
inputs: particle transitions and scalar/context operation steps
requirements.applicability: All selected evaluations consuming this resource
acceptance: Define accounting for particle transitions and scalar/context operation steps using MaxRuleSteps; exhaustion is resource/incomplete rather than a MusicXML failure.

requirements.title: Bound accumulated context
requirements.applicability: All selected evaluations consuming this resource
acceptance: Define accounting for retained effective-state and origin facts using MaxContextFacts; exhaustion is resource/incomplete rather than a MusicXML failure.

requirements.title: Bound linked-document count and aggregate depth
inputs: resolved child occurrences/identities and active link chain
requirements.applicability: All selected evaluations consuming this resource
acceptance: Define accounting for resolved child occurrences/identities and active link chain using MaxLinkedDocuments plus shared depth/bytes; exhaustion is resource/incomplete rather than a MusicXML failure.

requirements.title: Bound diagnostic count and byte volume
inputs: stored findings, rendered values and terminal summary
requirements.applicability: All selected evaluations consuming this resource
acceptance: Define accounting for stored findings, rendered values and terminal summary using MaxDiagnostics and MaxDiagnosticBytes; exhaustion is resource/incomplete rather than a MusicXML failure.

requirements.title: Bound model traversal volume
inputs: visited model occurrences, fields and choice entries
requirements.applicability: All selected evaluations consuming this resource
acceptance: Define accounting for visited model occurrences, fields and choice entries using MaxNodes/MaxRuleSteps with explicit model accounting; exhaustion is resource/incomplete rather than a MusicXML failure.

requirements.title: Cancel between bounded operations and preserve causes
requirements.applicability: All active source/model/package assessments
acceptance: Check cancellation between reads, tokens, operator steps, traversal and resolver work.
Finish cleanup once even under canceled context; retain earlier findings and mark incomplete.

requirements.title: Gate each implementation slice on relevant regressions and CI
requirements.applicability: Every future code implementation change
acceptance: Run relevant unit/regression tests plus generation, formatting, vet, tests on three operating systems, race, fuzz and external XSD conformance.

requirements.title: Compare original source facts against independent oracles
requirements.applicability: Source grammar, lexical, attribute and XML correctness checks
acceptance: Validate original input where the oracle applies, in addition to useful Decode -> Encode -> xmllint output checks.
Use independent exact arithmetic/grammar references when appropriate and label limitations.

requirements.title: Use obligation coverage rather than corpus size for readiness
requirements.applicability: Profile readiness and release claim review
acceptance: Cover branch/repetition, numeric bounds, presence/default/fixed, contextual scope, namespaces, incomplete outcomes and offline diagnostics.
Corpus runs are regression supplements; each mandatory applicable obligation has tested assessment or a declared tested limitation.

requirements.title: Approve concrete Go API and acyclic package ownership
requirements.applicability: Before affected public API/package implementation

requirements.title: Approve compiled catalog delivery, stable IDs and pin updates

acceptance: Choose compact-catalog generation/import mechanism, runtime ID freezing/revision rules, operator/compilation format and reproducible pin updates.
